detail.common_cause_note: a shared dependency that is itself adverse is RETAINED as an alternative explanation, not adopted as the answer: one rail fault and two coincident faults downstream of it produce the same evidence here
detail.domains_excluded_note: affirmatively NOMINAL, contributing no candidate -- these explanations were looked at and found unsupported by the evidence, which is not the same as not having been considered
detail.why: several components carry adverse evidence and nothing separates them

cross_domain_relations.description: actuator demand implies an expected current draw; a commanded actuator drawing nothing implicates the power path OR the actuator, and these signals do not separate them
CPU saturation produces processing latency produces a missed output deadline; the timing finding and the compute finding are one event seen twice
a source that has gone quiet behind a failing link is a communication candidate, not a sensor fault
sources sharing a rail degrade together when the rail sags; the rail is retained as a common-cause alternative rather than replacing the sensor explanation
